snippet.title: Medieval Dynasty: The Backwood - DLC reveal trailer - FGS Live From gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1129580/Medieval_Dynasty/

A reveal trailer for Medieval Dynasty's DLC The Backwood. The Backwood is the latest DLC for Medieval Dynasty, a medieval co-op crafting experience with an emphasis on building and survival.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
